newsitem.title: LATVIA: PM APPROVES DEFENCE POST CANDIDATE-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PM APPROVES DEFENCE POST CANDIDATE-REPORT.

text.p: Prime Minister Andris Shkele has agreed to back Talavs Jundzis' nomination for the vacant post of defense minister, The Diena newspaper reported on Friday.
Jundiz is the choice of the LNNK, the Peasant's Union and the Christian Democrats' block in the country's eight-party coalition, Diena said.
"Jundzis has researched the issue scientifically, is no stranger to NATO and is an honest person," Shkele was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
"I think he will be able to sort out the mismanagement (in the defence ministry)." Shkele told Diena.
Jundzis, the chairman of the Christian Democratic Party, was the first defence minister after Latvia regained its independence six years ago.

The previous defence minister, Andrejs Krastinsh, resigned on May 12 after Shkele demanded he quit over a scandal involving the purchase of fuel at what the premier regarded as suspiciously high prices.
